subject: CarePlus discovery — security & retention (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@careplushealth.com>, CarePlus Security <security@careplushealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: CarePlus discovery — security & retention (post-call recap)

Hi Olivia and CarePlus security team,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick post-call recap and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth. High level takeaways: 

- Primary pain: need demonstrable audit log retention and per-tenant export for regulators during quarterly reviews. Current vendor proof points are insufficient for your internal auditors.
- Controls requested: SOC 2 evidence for CC6/CC7 equivalents, retention policy showing 12 months with immutable snapshots, and a documented incident/forensics playbook.
- Tech ask: ability to export audit logs filtered by tenant or customer ID, and an automated archive export that can be handed to your security team within 30 days.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB) and retention-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB). These are high-level artifacts showing our SOC 2 scope and current retention defaults.

Proposed next steps and timeline:
1) Redwood to share SOC 2 artifact index and an export demo recording by EOD Friday (we attached the summary).
2) CarePlus to confirm required retention window and any regulatory language that must appear in the DPA.
3) Agree on pen test scope and timeline; you mentioned preferring an external test in Q4. If Q4 is firm, we can draft a coordinated plan by next week.

Ive copied Grace from Customer Success to coordinate the demo and Kim from Legal to start a DPA draft. If this looks right, reply with any edits and we will kick off the artifact package.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, retention-matrix.xlsx

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@careplushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CarePlus Security <security@careplushealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CarePlus discovery — security & retention (post-call recap)

Thanks Jordan — helpful recap. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- About audit log exports: can you confirm whether exports include original request metadata (IP, user agent, request ID) or only application-level events? Our auditors will require headers for traceability.
- For SOC 2: do you have the most recent report under NDA, or only the summary? We will need either the full report under NDA or an SOC 2 letter plus controls mapping.
- Pen test: Q4 is our target. We will share availability the week of Oct 11. We also need to see your proposed scope and any prior remediation tickets from previous tests.

Also please send a draft DPA with the retention clause you'd propose so our legal team can begin review.

Olivia Chen
VP Product, CarePlus Healthtech
security@careplushealth.com
---
Attachment stubs: none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@careplushealth.com>, CarePlus Security <security@careplushealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CarePlus discovery — security & retention (post-call recap)

Great questions, Olivia. Answers and updates below: 

- Audit export contents: exports include application events plus request metadata (timestamp, request ID, source IP, user agent) and a hash to assert integrity. We will prepare a short export sample sanitized for PII and share via secure link.
- SOC 2 artifacts: we can share the SOC 2 report under NDA. For speed, Im attaching the SOC 2 summary now and will send the full report once we have an executed NDA.
- Pen test history and scope: attached is a proposed scope template and a redacted remediation ledger from our last third-party test (pen-test-scope.xlsx). Suggest we align scope by next Thu (2027-08-13) so your procurement team can lock dates for Oct.

Action items I will take this week: 
- Jordan: circulate secured export sample and the SOC 2 artifact intake checklist by Friday. HubSpot record for the opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7654321
- Grace: schedule a 45-min export demo with CarePlus security (propose week of Aug 16).
- Kimberly: prepare a DPA first-draft and include a retention clause for 12 months with a 30-day export window; we will flag any unusual indemnity language.

Attachments included: pen-test-scope.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB).

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 415-555-0162
---
Attachment stubs: pen-test-scope.xlsx
Related link: https://app.docusign.com/documents/abcd-efgh-1234

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-08T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CarePlus discovery — security & retention (post-call recap)

Thanks — looping in Legal here. Quick notes from my side: 

- Ill draft a DPA redline that includes the 12-month retention and a 30-day export commitment. I will also propose language for audit access and subcontractor controls. Expect the first draft by EOD Monday.
- Please get me the sanitized SOC 2 report under NDA. I will prepare a short vendor questionnaire for CarePlus security to complete; that will help us map the control owners and evidence sources.
- On pen test: Ill include a clause for a coordinated test window and a remediation SLA to satisfy procurement. We can push suggested dates into the HubSpot opportunity.

Attachments for internal use: dpa-draft-careplus.docx, vendor-questionnaire.pdf

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment stubs: dpa-draft-careplus.docx, vendor-questionnaire.pdf
